Rust struct with name, verify structure name contains value

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"rust\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "pub struct MyConfig {\n    pub name: String,\n    pub value: i32,\n}\n\nimpl MyConfig {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self { name: String::new(), value: 0 }\n    }\n}\n", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.language())
debugPrint(result.structure())
```
